recordingBinding.notes: Decoded Genius song 2236 identifies Help!, release 1965-08-06 and EMI Studios London. The artist catalog agrees on original album, release date and recording location. Performance-level binding; no ISRC or exact digital master claim. Initial search-row album null is not absence of resolved album metadata.

independentSources.finding: The downloaded annotation labels Key F over 0.000-127.427 seconds for Help! track 13. Its SHA256 is 3d38d6d964df0e5b6b3e0117e70fc208efdf71322fd6f71a048fa40cea6b71e9. This supports the main key, not completeness of local modulations.

independentSources.role: Primary annotation methodology and source-CD catalog
independentSources.finding: Identifies Help! CDP 7 46439 2 as audio source and warns Beatles main-key annotations can omit local key changes. No exact audio/master hash is supplied.

independentSources.role: Primary scholarly harmonic analysis by Richard Repp, College Music Symposium, 2009
independentSources.finding: Identifies F major established by tonic chords and analyzes motion to relative D minor and return to F. The author explicitly notes pedagogical simplification and differing interpretations of local modulation; this is main-key corroboration, not a complete transcription.

catalogCrosscheck.durationCaveat: Different stated duration and annotation extent do not establish bit-identical master. Scope is the original album performance, not timing or audio-byte identity.

verificationDecision: Global sounding/home key F major only. Independent C4DM annotation identifies main key F; scholarly harmonic analysis distinguishes the relative D-minor regions. No claim that every section stays in F, and no full chord/lyric accuracy is certified.
limits: No full lyrics or chord-placement gold reference is added.
G-shape/whole-step-down guitar explanations are not used as standalone sounding-key proof.
